graphic.title:
Human in the loop
until 90 percent
lines: A person checks the system from day one
The system proves more than 90 percent reliability
The hand-over is a decision, not a toggle
Someone signs it, and the name stays written

editorial.reader: Operations lead at a manufacturer running an automation pilot
editorial.insight: A person stays in the loop until 90 percent reliability is shown, then someone signs; hand-over is a decision with a name
editorial.discussion_reason: Some will argue 90 percent is arbitrary or too low
